context:
Goal: no reviewed PR waits, and your own asks do not stall.
Problem (rule): your 21:42 CST hold lets only the lanes that land the queue fixes start. It says nothing about lanes for asks you made yourself, so the coordinator needs your word.
Based on (ruling): your words at 21:42 CST, "ill allow holding off on spawning new lanes but u shd still be able to spawn the lanes that will result in these fixes landing" (item 384; record lane-inflow-hold on PR #1768).
Departs from: main — adds your own asks to the lanes the hold lets start.
Meanwhile: your asks wait, the stricter reading. One waits now: blank roadmap pages (your ask of Nov 4).

options.how: A lane for an ask you made starts during the hold, as the queue-fix lanes do.
options.label: Your own asks still start (recommended)
options.lose: More lanes feed the queue while it drains.

options.how: Only the queue-fix lanes start until you lift the hold.
options.label: They wait too
options.lose: Your asks wait until you lift the hold.

reply: Routed: your own asks still start new lanes during the hold. Home: the note on step pr-backlog-clear, and the coordinator's record lane-inflow-hold on PR #1768. Blank roadmap pages and child-question-checks-home can now start. Triage, 22:26 CST.
short: Your asks during the lane hold
title: Do your own asks still start new lanes during the hold?
why: The coordinator recommends a: your asks are few, so they add little to the queue.
